observations.refusal_row: API error row, invalid_request, stop_reason refusal, stop_details is the supplied refusal object; explanation is null at the actual server-fallback callsite.
observations.model_gate: eYe(servingModel) controls the model-labelled refusal branch. Its catalog/settings-backed KI decision is pinned but supplied as modelEligible in this formatter probe.
observations.help_links: The generic help link is selected by b1r from the serving-model identity: Opus 5 routes to /16049681, Fable identities/aliases and the configured default Fable route to /15363606, and other or absent identities to /8106465.
observations.first_party_copy: The no-displayable-model cyber branch is special only for provider kind firstParty, anthropicAws, anthropicGoogleCloud, or gateway; the provider and interactive/feedback facts are injected in this probe.
observations.family_copy: Native family lookup enables first-time wording for the configured sonnet family on cyber; claude-opus-5-5 is an additional explicit first-time model. Actual family lookup is injected from the dynamic model catalog.
observations.output_accumulator: je receives projected user rows from completed tool results and attachment rows; tool-returned newMessages are queued as completed executor rows, so whole-je cleanup is broader than raw tool_result.
